cohort: A single 17-year-old man presenting with hematuria, hematospermia, and testalgia, with a history of right-sided renal dysgenesis at birth.
finding: Fluoroscopic investigation and MRI revealed an ectopic right ureter implanted into the right ejaculatory duct, causing obstruction with mucin balls, which was successfully treated with robot-assisted laparoscopic nephroureterectomy and removal of the mucin balls.
